Hello There! 👋

I’m **Federica Domecq**, an M.S. in Statistics Student and Teaching Assistant at Wake Forest University. Originally from **Madrid, Spain 🇪🇸**, I moved to the U.S. to pursue my education and recently graduated from Pomona College with a double major in Mathematics & Computer Science.


On this website you can learn a little bit [about me](about.qmd), my [research](academicprojects/projects.qmd) and some of my [data wrangling efforts](smallprojs/index.qmd)!
